# ServeOS

> ServeOS is a next-generation hospitality operations platform for restaurants, cafes, bars, food trucks, hotels, and event venues. It combines QR-code table ordering, kitchen display, table and order management, staff permissions, and payments into a single system.

Guests scan a QR code at their table to browse a live menu and order directly from their phone. Staff and owners manage orders, kitchen tickets, tables, menus, staff access, and payments from a web dashboard.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and marketing landing page.
- [About](/about): Information about ServeOS.

## Notes for AI agents

- The customer ordering flow (`/customer/menu`) is scoped to a single table session via QR code or session cookie. It cannot be browsed generically without an active session, so it is not listed as a stable public URL here.
- Dashboard, order management, kitchen display, menu management, staff, and account pages require authentication and are not part of the public site — do not attempt to summarize or cite them as public content.
